question: What is the main goal of an inflow and infiltration reduction program for a sanitary sewer system?
correctAnswer: To reduce clear water entering the sanitary sewer
explanation: Inflow and infiltration programs reduce clear water that enters the sanitary sewer, freeing capacity and lowering the risk of surcharge and overflows.
options: To increase peak flow reaching the treatment plant
To replace all gravity sewers with force mains
To raise groundwater levels around sewer pipes
To reduce clear water entering the sanitary sewer
optionA: To increase peak flow reaching the treatment plant
optionB: To replace all gravity sewers with force mains
optionC: To raise groundwater levels around sewer pipes
optionD: To reduce clear water entering the sanitary sewer

Industrial discharge

Sanitary base flow

It has no effect because air compresses out of the way
It cools the wastewater and reduces odour formation
It reduces the effective flow area and increases the head the pump must overcome

optionB: It has no effect because air compresses out of the way
optionC: It cools the wastewater and reduces odour formation

Cold wastewater moving quickly through a force main

optionB: High chlorine residual throughout the collection system
optionC: Anaerobic bacteria in slime layers reduce sulfate while wastewater is septic

The force main removes all dissolved oxygen treatment chemicals
The discharge manhole is always the lowest point in the system

question: Concrete sewer crowns corrode from sulfide attack through which sequence?
correctAnswer: Hydrogen sulfide in the sewer air is converted to sulfuric acid on the moist crown, and the acid attacks the concrete
explanation: Hydrogen sulfide released to the sewer atmosphere is oxidized to sulfuric acid on the moist crown above the flow, and the acid deteriorates the concrete.
options: Sulfide freezes on the crown and cracks the concrete in winter
Hydrogen sulfide in the sewer air is converted to sulfuric acid on the moist crown, and the acid attacks the concrete
Grease coats the crown and dissolves the cement binder directly
Roots enter the crown and widen existing cracks
optionA: Sulfide freezes on the crown and cracks the concrete in winter
optionB: Hydrogen sulfide in the sewer air is converted to sulfuric acid on the moist crown, and the acid attacks the concrete
optionC: Grease coats the crown and dissolves the cement binder directly
optionD: Roots enter the crown and widen existing cracks
sourceTitle: US EPA — CMOM Guide for Sanitary Sewer Collection Systems

question: A public main is lined, but flow monitoring shows I&I continuing at one service connection where the lateral meets the main. What does this indicate for the program?

explanation: Lining the main does not by itself seal the lateral connection; an unsealed interface remains an entry point and needs a connection seal or lateral work.

The flow meter needs a new battery

The property should be billed for the full basin flow

optionB: The flow meter needs a new battery

question: A collapsed sewer main must be bypass pumped for two days while it is replaced. Which bypass arrangement is adequate for the emergency plan?

Tanker trucks alone, regardless of the flow arriving at the site
